summary: r450k downloads still didn't work after removing target="_blank": the Worker's /api/download/<id> 302-redirected the browser to GitHub's signed CDN URL, and that cross-origin download-via-redirect behaves inconsistently in browsers (blank tab, or bouncing to the top of the page, without ever downloading). The Worker now proxies the asset and streams the bytes back as a SAME-ORIGIN response with Content-Disposition: attachment (Cloudflare streams the body, so nothing is buffered), which downloads reliably from a plain same-tab link in every browser. GitHub auth (needed for the private repo) is applied to the API call and dropped automatically when fetch follows the redirect cross-origin to the signed URL.
compatibility: Frontend/Worker-only change on the r450k static marketing site; no impact on the Go apps or their versioned releases. Slightly more Cloudflare egress since asset bytes now stream through the Worker instead of redirecting.
